response.sql:
WITH site_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg_faces
  FROM sites s
  INNER JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
overall_avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(sm.facetfaces) as overall_avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh sm
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.entrystat,
    AVG(sa.site_avg_faces) as status_avg_faces
  FROM site_avgs sa
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sa.entrystat
),
focused_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.site_avg_faces,
    sta.status_avg_faces,
    oa.overall_avg_faces
  FROM site_avgs sa
  INNER JOIN status_avgs sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa
  WHERE sa.site_avg_faces > sta.status_avg_faces
    AND oa.overall_avg_faces IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  AVG(fs.site_avg_faces) as avg_face_count,
  AVG(fs.site_avg_faces - fs.overall_avg_faces) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(fs.site_avg_faces - fs.status_avg_faces) as avg_above_status
FROM focused_sites fs

assumptions.assumption: The overall average of mesh faces should include all facetfaces from all mesh records in scanmesh (regardless of the site's access status), per the explicit statement '(sites without an access status included)'.

Only sites with at least one mesh record having non-NULL facetfaces are included in site-level averages, and only those with non-NULL entrystat participate in status-level comparisons or become focused sites.
'Strictly above' means the strict inequality > rather than >=.
